source_name: Pla ALFA — daily fire-risk level (Agents Rurals)
text: Pla ALFA reaches level 3 on route comarques tomorrow. Municipalities at level 3+: Agramunt (Urgell, level 3), Aitona (Segrià, level 3), Almatret (Segrià, level 3), Bellprat (Anoia, level 3), Cardona (Bages, level 3), Ciutadilla (Urgell, level 3), el Pont de Vilomara i Rocafort (Bages, level 3), els Omells de na Gaia (Urgell, level 3). Level 3 prohibits open flame everywhere, suspends authorised stubble/pasture/pruning burns, and bans spark-generating machinery on forest land and within 500 m — but it does NOT restrict access on foot. A pilgrim on a marked path breaks no level-3 rule.
